design_correction.finding: A late refusal after the main restore commits retains its journal; startup recovery then repeats refusal behind StartupRecoveryGate, blocking the normal benchmark UI needed for reconciliation. Confirmed in GPTMobileApp, CompleteBackupManager, MainViewModel and MainActivity source.
design_correction.decision: Preserve b715 direct ownership-closure merge. Known pending ownership rejects bulk restore before wider mutations. A separate typed path used only after proven complete-restore main commit retains the entire current benchmark section without replacement writes, reports the retained outcome through existing result/warning channels, and finalizes the already committed wider restore. No startup bypass or cross-database transaction.
design_correction.preserved_tables: Current runs, batches, queue, attempts, events, snapshots and runtime evidence remain untouched by replacement on retention. Canonical current history must remain accessible for cleanup.
design_correction.cold_initialization: Existing loadLocked read/optional republish is transaction-protected before final authoritative replacement/retention; stale initialization cannot erase a newly persisted pending row.
